commitments.detail: Adopt OpenID Connect for portal authentication, replacing the existing mixture of password-based access and long-lived service tokens.
Enable a service-account adapter for the 17 existing service accounts that cannot use OpenID Connect yet, and include a registration task for all 17 accounts.
Portal authentication records must be retained for exactly 365 days.
Establish a quarterly access review process for portal authentication.
